scope_note: Everything. A service is in scope if it runs the target's code or stores the target's data regardless of vendor hostname (Heroku apps, AWS ALB origins, etc. are first-party). All *.amenitiz.io and *.amenitiz.com hosts in scope. crt.sh surfaced extra in-scope hosts on amenitiz.io (bookingsuite, get, *.infra, awsinfra-*). No new registrable domains encountered.
session_goal: Maximum impact: P1 / PII / High+Critical CVSS. Exploit phase.
recon_status: Surface mapped. EXPLOIT BLOCKER: Cloudflare managed challenge (4546-4547 byte 'Attention Required' pages) stands on all app paths of every CF-fronted host (booking engine, app, import-bookings/leadgen deep paths). The agent proxy IP cannot pass the JS challenge and browser-UA spoofing is policy-denied (Bot Check Circumvention). Only non-CF hosts (pay/pay-s Go gateways, pay-t ALB) and public DNS are curl-reachable.

import-bookings CORS: reflects arbitrary Origin BUT no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true (confirmed on GET + OPTIONS preflight). Browser blocks cross-origin read of cookie-authed responses. Low/non-finding per task rubric.
leadgen CORS: static ACAO http://localhost:3000, does NOT reflect attacker origin. Non-finding.
pay.amenitiz.io Go gateway: only /status responds (200 'ok'); all other paths return Go '404 page not found'. No routes discoverable without signed requests.
pay-t.amenitiz.io ALB: fixed 503 (162 bytes) for every Host header tested (app/booking/pay hosts) - dead ALB, no listener rules, NOT a CF-origin-bypass path.
infra sub-subdomains (dev/qa/prod/staging-3.infra, awsinfra-*): TLS handshake failure / timeout - dead/unreachable.

T1 cross-tenant IDOR via subdomain pivot on /en/api/v1/dashboards/*: backend returns 403 {"errors":"not allowed to access this Hotel"}. Tested with authenticated session (hotel A) against hotel B subdomain. Proper per-tenant auth check in place.

T1b HTML shell bootstrap leak: /en/api/v1/{reservations,guests,invoices,me,current_user} on another hotel subdomain returns 200 generic admin SPA shell (91256 bytes) with NO tenant-specific data (no hotel name, email, plan, owner, timezone — data-tz is just Rails default Europe/Paris).

T2 pms-object-id-endpoints: bookings 404 not_found, invoices uniform 422 regardless of ID format (numeric, UUID, slug, hashid), payments 404 not_found, guests/reservations 406. No IDOR oracle on any tested endpoint.
T5 mass-assignment-own-user: /en/api/v1/me, /users/me, /current_user all return 406 on GET and PATCH with JSON Accept. No writable user endpoint at these paths.
T6 graphql-on-tenant: all five candidate paths (/graphql, /en/graphql, /api/graphql, /en/api/graphql, /en/api/v1/graphql) return 406 on POST. No GraphQL endpoint on tenant subdomain.
T8 pms-frontend-api-discovery: page navigations kill JS interceptors (full page loads not SPA). Inline scripts reveal jQuery AJAX endpoints at /en/admin/booking-manager/* but all return 404.
T9 property/settings: returns 200 null (empty, no data exposed).

T10 cross-tenant /api/v1/ via subdomain pivot: tested with two accounts (houseinstra property_id=47559, houseinstra-2 property_id=48120). Visiting houseinstra-2 with first account session returns IDENTITY property_id=47559. Backend resolves tenant from session not subdomain. /api/v1/rooms,extras,clients all return own tenant data. hotel_id/property_id parameters ignored. Fully ruled out.

T11 api.amenitiz.io vendor API: OAuth server at /oauth/token (Doorkeeper). Supports authorization_code + refresh_token + PKCE S256. Public client (token_endpoint_auth_methods: none). Scopes: inventory:read, rates:read, ari:read, bookings:read, finance:read, settings:read. No discoverable API routes without valid bearer token. /api/v1/regions is the only unauthenticated endpoint.
T12 OAuth endpoints on tenant: /oauth/token, /oauth/authorize, /oauth/applications all 406 on tenant subdomain. Only live on api.amenitiz.io.
